features.name: Moderation & cases
features.summary: Warn, mute, timeout, kick and ban, each kept as a case with the member's history.
features.lead: The everyday moderation commands. Every action is saved as a case, so a member's history is one command away, and repeated warnings can lead to a timeout.
points: Warn, mute, timeout, kick and ban, from slash commands or right-click.
Every action is a case with the moderator and reason.
/infractions shows one member's whole history.
After a set number of warnings, a timeout is offered.
use: Act on a member: `/warn`, `/mute`, `/timeout`, `/kick` or `/ban`, or right-click them › Apps.
See their history: `/infractions`.
Warnings before a timeout is offered: `/warn-settings threshold`; its length: `/warn-settings duration`.
Log actions: `/setup mod-logs`; deleted messages: `/setup cleared-log`.

why.title: Cases, not just actions
why.text: A ban on its own says nothing next month. Keeping each action as a case with its reason is what makes /infractions and appeals possible.

features.name: Softban & appeals
features.summary: Locks a member into one channel where they can appeal, instead of banning them.
features.lead: A softban takes a member's roles and leaves them one channel. After a wait they can open an appeal ticket, and staff approve or deny it with a button.
points: The member keeps their place but sees only the softban lobby.
After a wait, an Appeal button opens a private ticket.
Staff approve or deny from the ticket; approving gives their roles back.
Softbans survive leaving and rejoining.
use: Softban: `/softban`. Members without the permission can `/request-softban`.
Set the softban role and lobby channel: `/setup softban`.
Decide an appeal: the buttons in the ticket, or `/appeal approve` and `/appeal deny`.
Lift it early: `/unsoftban`.

why.title: A way back
why.text: A ban gives no room to explain. Keeping the member in one channel lets them appeal without DMs, and keeps the decision in front of staff.

features.name: Private VCs
features.summary: Join one channel to get your own voice room, with a menu to lock, rename or invite.
features.lead: Joining the "Join to create" channel makes a voice room for you and moves you in. Menus in the room let you lock, hide, rename and limit it, or kick and block people.
points: Join one channel, get your own room.
Lock, hide, rename and set a user limit from menus in the room.
Kick or block people; hand the room to someone else.
The room is deleted when everyone has left.
use: Set it up: `/setup voice` with the categories and your mod role.
Use it: join "Join to create", then use the menu in your room.
rules: The panel is usable by the room's owner, admins and the configured mod role only; being in the room grants nothing.
The mod role gets a full-bypass overwrite on every room: it sees and joins locked and hidden rooms.
The owner, bots, admins and mods can't be kicked or blocked.
Blocks are channel permission overwrites, so they disappear when the room is deleted.
Kick counts are kept in memory: cleared when the room is deleted, reset when the bot restarts.
The muted role can't see or join "Join to create", is silently disconnected if it lands there anyway, and can see but never connect to rooms; that deny is re-applied on unlock and show.
A room is deleted the moment its owner leaves, or when it becomes empty; deleting one by hand removes its record too.
`/setup voice` refuses to run until `/setup mute-role` has stored a mute role that still exists, and re-running it replaces the config and deletes the old join channel.
